scientific_integrity: Existence, stability, positivity and asymptotics follow from an analytic proof; exact rational checks and numerical tests are supplementary. Published classical Duffing symmetry and prior unforced exponential-fiber drift are not claimed as novel. No independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Local small-forcing periodic branch only; the planar basin is not globally classified. Quartic-coefficient sign reversal is not reversal of the positive total drift; no hardware outcomes are inferred. The date identifies the originating model, not priority for this new result.
title: Positive exponential-fiber drift and a sharp quartic response reversal on forced Duffing cycles
